publication_copy.headline: One More Bag
publication_copy.body: The river did not arrive as a wall. It climbed a little, found a gap, and waited for Red Leopards to believe the last sandbag had solved it. The old goal leaned over a pitch still carrying last week's damage. Red Leopards shifted another bag into place. The water went around it. In 2022, he had beaten El Niño twice and carried thirteen wins into the semifinal. It was not the strength of the old season he remembered now, but how little of it had mattered on the night it ended.
